result.title: BAPLe++: Cross-Model Transferability and Prompt-Level Defense of Backdoors in Medical Foundation Models
result.summary: Medical foundation models (Med-FMs) are increasingly adapted to clinical tasks through prompt learning, which tunes a small set of prompt tokens while the backbone remains frozen. Recent work has shown that this efficiency introduces a vulnerability: jointly optimizing learnable prompts and an imperceptible noise trigger during few-shot adaptation implants a backdoor that leaves clean performance intact but steers triggered inputs to an attacker-chosen class. Since prompts are compact and readily shared, this raises two questions: whether a backdoored prompt remains effective on a different Med-FM, and whether it can be repaired without retraining the backbone. We address both in BAPLe++. First, we present the first study of cross-model transferability of prompt-based backdoors, quantified by two proposed metrics, Clean Accuracy Difference (CAD) and Backdoor Accuracy Difference (BAD). Second, we propose DePLe (Defense via Prompt Learning), which uses the infected prompt as a fixed anchor and learns a new prompt on a small clean set that preserves the clean task while diverging from the compromised embedding region. Experiments on four Med-FMs and six chest X-ray and histopathology datasets show that backdoors transfer across models, but asymmetrically and in a dataset-dependent manner. Compared with four training-free input transformations, DePLe reduces backdoor accuracy more consistently while preserving, and in several settings improving, clean accuracy. Our code can be accessed on https://github.com/Ufaqkhan/Baple-Plus-Plus

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究医学基础模型中基于 prompt learning 的后门攻击的跨模型迁移性，提出 CAD/BAD 两个指标度量迁移程度，并给出 DePLe 防御：以受感染 prompt 为固定锚点，在少量干净数据上学习新 prompt，使其保留干净任务同时偏离被污染的嵌入区域。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「紧凑 prompt 表征携带的行为可跨不同 backbone 迁移」及「在嵌入空间中约束新状态远离受污染区域」的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的跨模型可迁移性度量、表征编辑与污染/旁路检测提供可供核查的线索，但任务与视觉推理无直接关联。
